data.name: Farhad
data.gender_notes: Farhad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Farhad is a Persian name that means 'unique' or 'precious'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the value and importance of an individual. It is also associated with courage and bravery. The name Farhad carries the meaning “Unique, Precious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farhad usually hope their child will grow to embody unique, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran emphasizes the importance of every individual being unique and precious in the eyes of Allah (Quran 49:13).
data.etymology: Farhad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unique, Precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farhad total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: فرهاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: فرهاد هو اسم فارسي الأصل يتكون من جزأين فر وهد حيث فر تعني الفرح والسرور وهد تعني الشخص أو الإنسان، وبالتالي يكون معنى فرهاد الشخص الذي يفرح دائما أو من يبشر بالسعادة والرفاهية، وقد وجد هذا الاسم ذكره في التاريخ الإسلامي حيث كان أحد أسماء الصحابة، ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء المهمة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يرمز إلى الفرح والسرور والرضا

in_urdu.name: فرہاد
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرہاد کا نام فارسی زبان سے لیا گیا ہے جس کے دو حصے ہیں فر اور ہد جہاں فر کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور سرور اور ہد کا مطلب ہے شخص یا انسان، اس لیے فرہاد کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو ہمیشہ خوش رہتا ہے یا جو خوشی اور خوشحالی کا باعث بنتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں بھی ملتا ہے جہاں یہ ایک صحابی کا نام تھا، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم ہے جہاں یہ خوشی اور سرور کا پرچم لہراتا ہے

in_english.name: Farhad
in_english.long_meaning: Farhad is a name of Persian origin, composed of two parts: far and had. Far means happiness and joy, while had means person or human. Therefore, Farhad means a person who is always happy or a source of happiness and prosperity. This name is also found in Islamic history as the name of a companion, and it holds importance in Islamic culture as a symbol of joy and happiness

data.cultural_impact: In the Persian epic story "Layla and Majnun", Farhad is the name of the lover of Shirin. The story is a tragic tale of love, separation and devotion. Farhad is renowned for his strength and courage. He was employed by Shahryar to build a bridge over the Aقa Qeyssarun river for his bride-to-be, but his love for Shirin distracted him, and the bridge was never completed. This example of love and devotion has had a significant impact on Persian and Islamic culture, inspiring poetry, art, and literature.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Farhad symbolizes self-sacrifice and dedication to one's love, whether it be for God or for a loved one. It underscores the value of each individual, reminding us of the potential for great courage and selflessness that lies within each of us. It encourages us to pursue our passions with determination and to remain committed to our beliefs and values, even in the face of adversity.
